description: This file defines the HarBackend class responsible for handling HAR (HTTP Archive) files, including response lookup, content loading, and redirect following, within the Playwright core server.

classes.name: HarBackend
classes.description: A class that manages HAR file responses, including lookup, content loading, and redirect handling.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup in the HAR file for a given request, returning the appropriate response action.

methods.name: _loadContent
methods.description: Loads response content from a file or inline text, returning a Buffer.

methods.name: _harFindResponse
methods.description: Finds the matching HAR entry for a given request, following redirects if necessary.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, such as closing the zip file.
